description: Lists the certified chats of one case file. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId (chats live in the user's personal case file). Optional filters: filter.search (free text), filter.service (Telegram), filter.status, filter.createdFrom and filter.createdUntil (creation-date range, ISO 8601), filter.id (one chat's id). Status: creating — just created, waiting for the messaging platform to confirm it; until then its messages, participants, invitation URL and certificates answer 404; active — confirmed and usable; inactive — defined by the API but not set by the current platform version. order.title or order.createdAt sorts ASC or DESC; page.number (from 1) and page.size (up to 100, default 20) paginate. Returns { data, meta }; use an item's id as chatId in chat_get, chat_message_list and chat_certificate_create.
name: chat_list
